name: San Diego — Lake Murray Loop
author: prodrive-ac-builder
_about: A drivable LOOP around Lake Murray (Kevin's childhood neighborhood), built through the EXACT proven Sand Creek pipeline (build_kn5.py native Blender ribbon + grass -> export_kn5_addon), NOT the from-scratch network path. Source = the 'Lake Murray Blvd round-trip' loop from the My Maps export. Loop, not freeroam, because the loop pipeline is what actually collides in-game.

source._doc: data/centerline.geojson is provided directly from the road-snapped loop line, so the gps/centerline Overpass stage is skipped; elevation -> projection -> build_kn5 consume it.

layouts._doc: The Lake Murray loop. Single layout, one kn5.
